shortDescription: Executes a SQL non-DQL(Data Query Language) statement

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: database
options.description: Specified database name, usually, its the iasp name, use WRKRDBDIRE to check Relational Database Directory Entries Default to use the C(*LOCAL) entry

options.name: joblog
options.description: If set to C(true), output the JOBLOG even success.

options.name: sql
options.description: The C(ibmi_sql_execute) module takes a IBM i SQL non-DQL(Data Query Language) statement to run.
